chunks: Except one old woman who remained behind.
ai.seo_question: Who was the old woman that remained behind in the story of Lut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the mother of Prophet Lut (or a specific elderly woman among his people) who remained behind due to her attachment to worldly life or delay, serving as a cautionary example of those who fail to heed the divine command to flee promptly. This exception underscores the urgency of the 'hasty departure' (hurrying) emphasized in the narrative, contrasting the faithful's swift obedience with the complacency of the disbelievers.
